name: Aurellion diamond uninitialized initialize takeover
summary: The owner's diamondCut registered the SafeOwnable facet's initialize(address) selector without invoking any initializer, leaving the OpenZeppelin guard slot at zero on a diamond whose ownership had never written it. The attacker called initialize() to seize ownership, cut in a malicious facet exposing pullERC20, and swept outstanding user USDC approvals via transferFrom.

loss.notes: Exact attacker receipts in the single anchor transaction: 450999.723188 USDC from 0x2e933518068b1cfc9746d94762ef2eddd39c6048, 3.0 USDC from 0xa90714a15d6e5c0eb3096462de8dc4b22e01589a, and 1.281433 USDC from 0xeced2d37e5edcfc67ffb74c655416f893d20793e via pullERC20 transferFrom, plus 5438.532001 USDC of diamond-held balance, all forwarded to the attacker EOA. No attacker-supplied campaign inputs besides gas.

ageReset.description: Owner diamondCut registered the SafeOwnable facet's initialize selector with an empty init call, writing the facet address into the diamond's selector-routing storage. The guard slot stayed zero, leaving initialize() open to any caller from this block.

sources.note: Anchor: 0x19cbafae517791e7e73403313d70440abf60558350e419df05c04f816998fe0a (block 462014667:1, 2026-05-12T10:04:11Z) is the sole exploit transaction, sent by fresh EOA 0x9f49591a3bf95b49cd8d9477b4481ce9da68d5ca (nonce 0) creating attack contract 0x4d7759e69cc973d338a1ea2fdb125c2b818f4d7e. The 40-frame callTracer trace shows the constructor calling diamond 0x0adc63e71b035d5c7fdb1b4593999fa1f296f1b2 with 0xc4d66de8 (initialize, DELEGATECALL into SafeOwnable facet 0x3ca79c1cf29b8d19f7c643bb6e6bc9c49762e70f), then 0x1f931c1c (diamondCut, DELEGATECALL into DiamondCutFacet 0x4415c7a891c2e53015f7a9e3818c366962c0f1c1) installing in-tx-created malicious facet 0x8e31a0be6b02098939167e4392064136ab5c738d, then pullERC20 transferFrom calls draining three victim approvals and a final transfer consolidating 456442.536622 USDC to the attacker EOA. No owner or privileged caller precedes the attacker: the diamond's legitimate owner 0x1866fd4a9e15e0005480b5171b63b43d2d507698 is unrelated to both attacker addresses. Age: the diamond proxy was created by top-level CREATE from the owner in 0x1f43d6deabbc9974fe837d6269bcc6b1f6259799f874ecbcfb06a46078410b2e at block 442701508:2 (2026-03-17T10:08:24Z); 19 blocks later the owner's diamondCut 0x1868d5d48ffc6b4c226208fcd2a5f70654456a77a173f81fe514ae15fabc86d1 at block 442701527:2 registered the initialize selector with empty init data. The routing slot reads zero at block 442701526 and the facet address at block 442701527 through pre-exploit, and facetAddress(0xc4d66de8) reverts before and resolves to the facet after, so the reachable-initializer state dates to the upgrade: 1778580251 minus 1773742108 equals 4838143 seconds. The malicious facet is attacker-installed machinery, not aged. Loss is exact receipted victim-side depletion at USDC par.
